THE RULE SYSTEM (plain words):
World: two continuous concentration fields u and v on a 64x64 square grid with wrap-around edges, started at their uniform steady state (u=b, v=b/(a+b^2)) plus small random noise. Rules, integrated forward in time: u changes at rate -u + a*v + u^2*v + D1*(Laplacian of u) + c1*div(u grad v); v changes at rate b - a*v - u^2*v + D2*(Laplacian of v) + c2*div(v grad u). The last terms make each species drift along the other's gradient, with strength and sign set by c1 and c2. Parameters: a=0.015, b=10, D1=0.01, D2=1000*D1. Setting: c1=c and c2=-c (opposite signs, so one species is drawn toward the other while the other is pushed away), c=0.17.
